srcAppId.description: The appId of the app that signed the token, and triggered the App to App communication

clientAppId.description:
Optional caller app id if different from the srcAppId. In this case source app is used as "federated identity".
I.e. the destination app is trusting source app to authenticate and authorize client apps and users. Note that the
client app identity is unlikely to exist in the destination app, so it is effectively FYI.

clientUserId.description:
Optional caller user id. destination app is trusting source app to authenticate and authorize calling user. This
user unlikely to exist in destination app, so it is effectively FYI.

destAppId.description: The destination/target app's appId in the App to App communication

userRoles.description: Roles of the user who issued App#call from the srcAppId.

isAsRoot.description: true if App#call was issued by platform code asRoot.

title:
This type represents an App Token. It is used to authenticate http requests between apps in a cluster,
during App#call.

App tokens should be prefixed and will be identified by 'c3app' when being sent across apps.
AppTokens can only be generated for the current App, as it must be signed by the current app's private key.
However, any destination app that has previously performed a public key exchange with the current App will be able
to verify the token signature.
name: AppToken
